subject: Coordination: enablement gaps and staging schedule for July launch
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T16:15:00Z
Subject: Enablement gaps + reasonable staging window for July launch

Team —

We need a tight checklist for launch readiness for the July feature drop (model routing + new caching defaults). I pulled together a quick matrix (attached) but want to surface the immediate asks so we can prioritize: 

1) Docs: canonical quickstart + one-pager for SREs (Karthik — can you confirm if the API changes require any example updates?)
2) Enablement: training session + recording for CS and AE squads; short checklist for onboarding customers into Dedicated or Private flows (Laura)
3) Rollout timing: minimal viable production (MVP) rollout window and fallback plan if we see latency regressions (Marc)
4) External commitments: ApexFinTech procurement expects a staging slot and contract timeline — we should align on dates this week

Attachments: MVP-rollout-matrix.xlsx (matrix of owners/risks), prod-staging-plan.gdoc (link stub)

Goal: Have owners and a recommended date range by EOD Thursday so I can brief product leadership on Friday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Product Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Enablement gaps + reasonable staging window for July launch

On 2026-07-12, Marissa Cole wrote:
> 1) Docs: canonical quickstart + one-pager for SREs (Karthik — can you confirm if the API changes require any example updates?)

Quick answer: yes — there are two small surface changes that need examples updated: 1) the routing policy enum adds "cost-tier" and 2) the streaming completion hint header (x-rw-stream-hint) is now recommended. Both do not change the SDK flows but the REST examples and the curl snippets need edits. I'll update the quickstart and push a draft by tomorrow noon.

Questions for the group:
- Do we want the quickstart to show both hosted + dedicated examples, or keep dedicated in a separate doc? (I can do both but it increases scope)
- Are we comfortable with the new default caching behavior for the MVP, or do we need an opt-out toggle documented explicitly?

I'll add comments to MVP-rollout-matrix.xlsx as I review.

—Karthik
Docs Engineer

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-14T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Enablement gaps + reasonable staging window for July launch

Thanks —

I can run a 45-minute enablement for CS + AE next Wednesday (July 22) and will record. Planning notes:
- Deck: 12 slides (what changed, customer impact, troubleshooting steps)
- Playbook: 1-page onboarding checklist + an escalation matrix (who to call for SLA anomalies)
- Lab: we need a dedicated staging account with the new routing flags enabled (Marcus, do you have an available slot?)

I've attached a draft quickstart (enablement-quickstart.pdf) with the table of troubleshooting commands. Karthik — if you can confirm the example snippets, I will lock the deck by Monday EOD.

If we push training to July 22, I'd like the staging window to be at least 3 business days prior (20–22) to validate migrations and run the troubleshooting playbook.

Laura Bennett
Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: enablement-quickstart.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-07-15T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Enablement gaps + reasonable staging window for July launch

Laura — thanks for the proposed slot.

Staging availability: I confirmed a staging pool next week (July 20–22) but it is limited to two concurrent customers due to capacity. If ApexFinTech needs a staging slot we should prioritize them because they requested dedicated capacity in their contract. I will tentatively reserve one slot for Apex pending procurement confirmation.

Rollout phases (proposed):
- Phase 0 (preflight, July 20–22): staging validation, run smoke tests, capture baseline latency profiles
- Phase 1 (gradual internal -> beta, July 23–26): route 10% traffic via canary routing policy, monitor error budget and p95 latency
- Phase 2 (wider beta, July 27–30): expand to 50% for selected customers, enable auto-fallback to previous model variant on regression

Escalation plan: if p95 latency degrades > 20% vs baseline for longer than 30 min, automatic rollback and paging to infra-oncall + Marcus Lin (me) + Laura.

Action items: 
- Karthik: publish quickstart updates (examples for cost-tier + stream hint) by 2026-07-16 17:00Z
- Laura: finalize deck + record on 2026-07-22; confirm runbook by 2026-07-19
- Marissa: brief PL on 2026-07-16 with updated matrix
- Marcus: tentatively reserve staging slot for Apex, will release if procurement doesn't confirm by EOD 2026-07-16

Forwarding to Apex procurement to ask for confirmation.
